correctness.rationale: Combinatorial data verified by re-running verify_hulls.py: fans complete primitive CCW, dets 4,1,5 and 1,1,2,3, anticanonical degree 5, T-witnesses, hull areas 10 vs 7, (B,I) (8,2) vs (7,1) all reproduce. The geometric core fails: the neck-stretching lemma asserts minimal Maslov-2 boundaries are exactly the fan rays for BOTH triangular and quadrilateral limits, with hull Hamiltonian-invariant up to GL(2,Z). Vianna Theorem 5.1 proves this only for triangular ATBDs, explicitly warning positivity is lost if the limit moment polytope is not a triangle and that non-triangular hulls cannot be described. The draft applies the triangular positivity/Reeb/minimal-orbit argument to a 4-ray limit (H2 rank 2) without addressing self-intersection, extra disk classes, or smoothing/ATF compatibility beyond a rank count, and its supporting wall-crossing sentence is false (algebraic mutation changes Newton polygons beyond GL+translation). The quadrilateral exact-hull identification, on which non-isotopy depends, is therefore unproved.

originality.rationale: Fused 3-direction search plus full-body inspection of the two decisive priors shows the exact tri-vs-quad dP5 pair is not recorded or implied. Vianna classifies triangular ATBDs and proves triangular hulls only, expressly excluding non-triangular limits; Pascaleff-Tonkonog proves general wall-crossing/mutation and infinite families with a 7-direction Bl4 seed, not these 3-ray vs 4-ray fans with areas 10 vs 7. No fused result contains the exact ray tuples, potentials, or hull census, and no broader census, dual encoding, or mutation corollary mechanically yields the claimed exact quadrilateral hull. The specific comparison is new under the shared standard.

value.rationale: If proved, the headline would be independently retrievable: exact Maslov-2 hulls distinguishing monotone Vianna fibres from two non-isomorphic toric degenerations of the natural object dP5, directly answering the admitted target and giving the first quadrangular instance of Vianna Conjecture 1.4 beyond triangular-triangular comparisons. Object and invariant were motivated before computation, values are not known or mechanically implied, and future work on ATF fibres, mutations, and qG degenerations could need the precise hulls. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
